cases.name: Chantee Alyce Woodman
cases.narrative: Barone and 24-year-old Leonard Benjamin Darcell II, an acquaintance from his days at the Forest Grove nursing home, picked her up from the Satyricon, a nightclub in downtown Portland. The two men then held her at hostage while Barone raped her. However, as she resisted fiercely, he instead shot her in the head, after which he and Darcell abandoned her body along the Sunset Highway.
